description: Shared org preset for tpsdev-ai repositories. Establishes the supply-chain posture: pin version updates, enforce a 7-day bake-time cooldown, and group non-major PRs so review surface stays small. Every update is proposal-only (automerge: false) — it must pass the full CI suite + K&S review before merge. See https://github.com/tpsdev-ai/flair/blob/main/docs/supply-chain-policy.md. Docker image digest pins are PROPOSED via Renovate's docker:pinDigests preset for Dockerfiles, compose files and workflow container/service images (the preset itself exempts argocd, devcontainer, helmv3 and pyenv); like every update here they are PRs, never automerged, so the protection — a republished tag cannot change the bytes we build or test on — holds for an image once its pin PR is merged.

packageRules.description: Group bun + npm non-major updates into a single PR so the review surface stays small. A red CI on a 60-package PR is hard to diagnose.
Group Python non-major updates into a single PR so the review surface stays small. A red CI on a 60-package PR is hard to diagnose.
Major updates land as their own PRs — they carry the most behavioral risk and deserve isolated review.
Group GitHub Actions into a single PR so sub-actions land together. CodeQL rejects mixed versions across sub-actions (bob#58/#99), so all codeql-action sub-actions must land in one PR.
Group Docker non-major updates into a single PR so the review surface stays small. A red CI on a 60-package PR is hard to diagnose.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
